ABOUT ACEDO

ACEDO Global – Your Strategic Global Engineering Service Integrator

Building More Than Machinery — Building Long-Term Success

ACEDO Global is more than an equipment supplier. We are a professional global engineering service
integrator headquartered in Xuzhou, China — internationally recognized as the capital of
construction machinery manufacturing.

Positioned at the intersection of advanced manufacturing, technical customization, and international
project execution, ACEDO Global serves as a trusted bridge between world-class Chinese equipment
resources and the real demands of global infrastructure development.

With business coverage in more than 60 countries, we support contractors, distributors, industrial
users, and government projects with reliable machinery solutions, technical expertise, and
end-to-end service.

Comprehensive Equipment Solutions

We provide carefully selected and professionally engineered equipment systems designed for
performance, durability, and efficiency in demanding environments.

Lifting & Access Equipment

Truck cranes, rough terrain cranes, aerial work platforms, spider cranes, and customized lifting
solutions built for safe and efficient operations.

Earthmoving & Road Construction

Excavators, wheel loaders, bulldozers, motor graders, pavers, rollers, and other heavy-duty machines
for infrastructure and mining projects.

Concrete & Port Equipment

Concrete pumps, mixer trucks, reach stackers, forklifts, port handling equipment, and specialized
logistics machinery.

Agricultural Machinery

Modern tractors, harvesters, planting equipment, and complete farming solutions for high-efficiency
agriculture.

Certified Used & Remanufactured Equipment

We specialize in high-quality pre-owned and remanufactured machinery. Each unit undergoes strict
technical inspection, refurbishment, and performance testing to ensure dependable working condition
and long service life.

Why Global Partners Choose ACEDO

Technical Customization & OEM Capability

We provide customized upper structures, chassis matching solutions, special-function modifications,
and private-label manufacturing according to local regulations and project needs.

Strict Quality Control

Our engineering team performs comprehensive inspections before shipment, covering structure,
hydraulic systems, powertrain, safety systems, and operational performance.

Integrated Global Supply Chain

From factory sourcing to export documentation, customs clearance, shipping, and final delivery, we
manage the full supply chain for a smooth and efficient procurement experience.

Flexible Commercial Solutions

We support international partners with professional payment arrangements including T/T, L/C, and
customized cooperation models for long-term growth.

Reliable After-Sales Support

We provide spare parts support, technical consultation, maintenance guidance, and responsive service
to keep your operations running efficiently.

Serving Projects Worldwide

From Southeast Asia, Central Asia, the Middle East, and Africa to Europe and Latin America, ACEDO
Global has become a trusted partner for contractors, rental companies, distributors, and industrial
enterprises worldwide.

We do not simply deliver machines — we deliver productivity, confidence, and long-term value.

ACEDO Global

WHY CHOOSE ACEDO

OEM & Customization

Leveraging our deep manufacturing roots in Xuzhou, we provide tailor-made engineering solutions and
OEM production to meet your specific project requirements.

Quality Inspection

Every machinery undergoes a rigorous 360-degree inspection with detailed reporting to ensure
zero-defect quality before global delivery.

Logistics & Shipping

Our seamless global logistics network ensures the safe, cost-effective, and timely transport of
heavy equipment to any destination worldwide.

After-sales Support

We provide life-long technical guidance and rapid spare parts response to ensure your equipment
maintains peak performance long after the sale.

ABOUT ACEDO

ACEDO Global – Your Strategic Global Engineering Service Integrator

Building More Than Machinery — Building Long-Term Success

ACEDO Global is more than an equipment supplier. We are a professional global engineering service
integrator headquartered in Xuzhou, China — internationally recognized as the capital of
construction machinery manufacturing.

Positioned at the intersection of advanced manufacturing, technical customization, and international
project execution, ACEDO Global serves as a trusted bridge between world-class Chinese equipment
resources and the real demands of global infrastructure development.

With business coverage in more than 60 countries, we support contractors, distributors, industrial
users, and government projects with reliable machinery solutions, technical expertise, and
end-to-end service.

Comprehensive Equipment Solutions

We provide carefully selected and professionally engineered equipment systems designed for
performance, durability, and efficiency in demanding environments.

Lifting & Access Equipment

Truck cranes, rough terrain cranes, aerial work platforms, spider cranes, and customized lifting
solutions built for safe and efficient operations.

Earthmoving & Road Construction

Excavators, wheel loaders, bulldozers, motor graders, pavers, rollers, and other heavy-duty machines
for infrastructure and mining projects.

Concrete & Port Equipment

Concrete pumps, mixer trucks, reach stackers, forklifts, port handling equipment, and specialized
logistics machinery.

Agricultural Machinery

Modern tractors, harvesters, planting equipment, and complete farming solutions for high-efficiency
agriculture.

Certified Used & Remanufactured Equipment

We specialize in high-quality pre-owned and remanufactured machinery. Each unit undergoes strict
technical inspection, refurbishment, and performance testing to ensure dependable working condition
and long service life.

Why Global Partners Choose ACEDO

Technical Customization & OEM Capability

We provide customized upper structures, chassis matching solutions, special-function modifications,
and private-label manufacturing according to local regulations and project needs.

Strict Quality Control

Our engineering team performs comprehensive inspections before shipment, covering structure,
hydraulic systems, powertrain, safety systems, and operational performance.

Integrated Global Supply Chain

From factory sourcing to export documentation, customs clearance, shipping, and final delivery, we
manage the full supply chain for a smooth and efficient procurement experience.

Flexible Commercial Solutions

We support international partners with professional payment arrangements including T/T, L/C, and
customized cooperation models for long-term growth.

Reliable After-Sales Support

We provide spare parts support, technical consultation, maintenance guidance, and responsive service
to keep your operations running efficiently.

Serving Projects Worldwide

From Southeast Asia, Central Asia, the Middle East, and Africa to Europe and Latin America, ACEDO
Global has become a trusted partner for contractors, rental companies, distributors, and industrial
enterprises worldwide.

We do not simply deliver machines — we deliver productivity, confidence, and long-term value.

Incorporated in 1975, Asian Engineering Group is among the pioneer when it comes to Material
Handling Equipment (MHE) rentals. We are the first Co. to introduce the concept of forklift hiring
in India . We service to a wide variety of clientele across diverse industries across India.

## Benefits to Renting a Lift Truck Versus Buying a Lift Truck
* #### Flexibility
  
  If your business is experiencing volatility, high growth or rapid change, the cost of purchasing a
  Lift Truck might be much greater than choosing rental option.
* #### Tax Advantages
  
  A Lift Truck rental might be considered an operational expense versus a capital expense. Using the
  expense to reduce taxable income can be simpler than depreciating a purchased asset. Leasing is a
  tax-deductible operational expense.
* #### Up to Date
  
  Leasing offers immediate access to the most up-to-date Lift Truck equipment on the market, with
  lower payments. You may have a predictable pattern of equipment usage, but the type of equipment
  may not always remain the same.Leasing is the smartest option.
* #### Budgeted Maintenance
  
  Every machine needs maintenance and repair. Renting a Lift Truck on a full service program removes
  the risk of costly and unexpected maintenance repairs since it is in our scope.
* #### Cheaper Option
  
  Some businesses experience seasonal highs and lows or quarterly inventory counts. Rentals can be a
  better option when the business can plan for predictable seasonal needs.

## Welcome To Asian Engineering Group

We Asian Engineering Group Provides Forklift & Stacker on Hire/Hiring, Forklift on rent & Stacker on
rent/renting and also these are available for Sale in Ranjangaon, Pune, Mumbai, Ankleshwar, Bharuch,

Incorporated in 1975, Asian Engineering Group is among the pioneer when it comes to Material
Handling Equipment (MHE) rentals. We are the first Co. to introduce the concept of forklift hiring
in India . We service to a wide variety of clientele across diverse industries across India.

## Benefits to Renting a Lift Truck Versus Buying a Lift Truck
* #### Flexibility
  
  If your business is experiencing volatility, high growth or rapid change, the cost of purchasing a
  Lift Truck might be much greater than choosing rental option.
* #### Tax Advantages
  
  A Lift Truck rental might be considered an operational expense versus a capital expense. Using the
  expense to reduce taxable income can be simpler than depreciating a purchased asset. Leasing is a
  tax-deductible operational expense.
* #### Up to Date
  
  Leasing offers immediate access to the most up-to-date Lift Truck equipment on the market, with
  lower payments. You may have a predictable pattern of equipment usage, but the type of equipment
  may not always remain the same.Leasing is the smartest option.
* #### Budgeted Maintenance
  
  Every machine needs maintenance and repair. Renting a Lift Truck on a full service program removes
  the risk of costly and unexpected maintenance repairs since it is in our scope.
* #### Cheaper Option
  
  Some businesses experience seasonal highs and lows or quarterly inventory counts. Rentals can be a
  better option when the business can plan for predictable seasonal needs.

About Us
HANGZHOU SIVGE MACHINERY CO., LTD

Hangzhou Sivge Machinery Co., Ltd.(Former Hangzhou Saiqi Engineering Machinery Plant) was founded in
1995 in Hangzhou -- a beautiful city full of vitality and creativity in China. SIVGE integrates
scientific research & development, manufacture and sales of various types of aerial work platforms
and contributes best to improve human aerial work condition. SIVGE persists in technological
innovation, with several countries invention patents, and more than 30 utility model patents. Our
products with their own intellectual property rights achieve advanced nature. SIVGE fully implements
international advanced management mode. In 2001, we established ISO9001 quality assurance system. In
2006, we established Occupational Health and Safety Management System (OHSAS) 18001 and Environment
Management System ISO14001. In 2002, our Aerial Work Platform from 6-18 meters passed the evaluation
of CE International Safety. In 2003, we became the first batch in the country to obtain the
Qualification Certificate for Aerial Work Platforms production. In 2007, a series of our
self-propelled aerial work platforms attained CE International Safety Certificate. In 2010, 9 series
of Sivge aerial work platforms attained CE according to the latest EN280 standard. With
"Customers-centered" principle, SIVGE has set up an integrated service system of design,
manufacture, sales and consultant. The sales network of SIVGE platforms has spread over China,
including Hong Kong area, Macau area and Taiwan area. Our products have been sold to more than 70
countries and regions in the world, including Europe, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, America and
Oceania.

About Us
HANGZHOU SIVGE MACHINERY CO., LTD

Hangzhou Sivge Machinery Co., Ltd.(Former Hangzhou Saiqi Engineering Machinery Plant) was founded in
1995 in Hangzhou -- a beautiful city full of vitality and creativity in China. SIVGE integrates
scientific research & development, manufacture and sales of various types of aerial work platforms
and contributes best to improve human aerial work condition. SIVGE persists in technological
innovation, with several countries invention patents, and more than 30 utility model patents. Our
products with their own intellectual property rights achieve advanced nature. SIVGE fully implements
international advanced management mode. In 2001, we established ISO9001 quality assurance system. In
2006, we established Occupational Health and Safety Management System (OHSAS) 18001 and Environment
Management System ISO14001. In 2002, our Aerial Work Platform from 6-18 meters passed the evaluation
of CE International Safety. In 2003, we became the first batch in the country to obtain the
Qualification Certificate for Aerial Work Platforms production. In 2007, a series of our
self-propelled aerial work platforms attained CE International Safety Certificate. In 2010, 9 series
of Sivge aerial work platforms attained CE according to the latest EN280 standard. With
"Customers-centered" principle, SIVGE has set up an integrated service system of design,
manufacture, sales and consultant. The sales network of SIVGE platforms has spread over China,
including Hong Kong area, Macau area and Taiwan area. Our products have been sold to more than 70
countries and regions in the world, including Europe, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, America and
Oceania.

## MAJOR Aerial Lift Operating Training Standard Went Into Effect On June 1st, 2020

The NEW ANSI (American National Standards Institute) standards A92.22-2018 & A92.24 – 2018
(effective June 1st, 2020) affect all operators, owners, and supervisors of aerial loft booms. This
is the first time in over 10 years that any changes have been made to the rules governing safety for
OSHA-compliant use of Aerial Lift Machines.

This means that the current OSHA standards will be OUTDATED, and you MUST comply with ANSI standards
or risk being cited as an owner, operator, or supervisor. These new mandatory standards require
updated training and certification to ensure better, safer operation and maintenance of mobile
Aerial Work Platforms, now referred to as Mobile Elevating Work Platforms (MEWP).

While other Aerial Lift Certification courses may be outdated and invalid after June 1st, 2020. You
can rest assured that CertifymeOnline.net covers the most recent standards in our training, giving
you peace of mind for a safe, injury-free workplace!

to deliver you the new training you need to stay OSHA compliant.

# Taking the industry forward with

][69][ Read More [Green arrow icon] ][70]

## A Legacy Of Excellence.
## A Tale Of Strength.

Being in the business for over four decades, Crescent Foundry is India’s leading exporter of
machined castings, counterweights, as well as airport and municipal casting solutions. Currently, we
export to over 57 countries worldwide. Our unified and driving purpose is to provide superior
quality products that have a global appeal.

Catering to varied sectors including agriculture, automotive, railways, telecom, highway
construction, port and airport infrastructure, material handling, oil & gas and more, we ensure our
clients receive the best and latest solutions crafted with advanced technology and modern designs.

Driven by a commitment to innovation and excellence, Crescent Foundry continues to expand its
capabilities and global footprint, maintaining a steadfast focus on delivering unmatched value and
reliability to our customers worldwide.

## Product Range

Our comprehensive product range of cast iron castings, counterweights and manhole covers is ideal
for sectors like telecom, airports, ports, industrial, agricultural, municipal, and more.

We are among the few foundries globally supplying high-performance airport access cover solutions to
major international airports, including Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore, and Hyderabad in India, as well as
Sydney Airport’s Qantas terminal, Dubai International Airport, and Hamad International Airport.

We also manufacture fully finished Grey Cast Iron Castings for a variety of applications and operate
a dedicated vacuum moulding line for counterweight production. Crescent Foundry was the first in
India to adopt this technology, with a current monthly capacity of 10,000 tons.

capabilities and global footprint, maintaining a steadfast focus on delivering unmatched value and
reliability to our customers worldwide.

# Aerial Work Platform Manufacturer in Pune, India

Daedalus Lift & Access Equipments Pvt. Ltd. is an Aerial Work Platform manufacturer in Pune, India.
We provide safe and efficient solutions for work at height. Our product range includes Scissor
Lifts, Boom Lifts, Rough Terrain Lifts, Push-able Lifts, and JIB Master solutions. Our machines help
businesses improve productivity and reduce downtime in demanding work environments.


Founded in 2017, Daedalus Lift and Access Equipments Pvt. Ltd.is located in Pune (MH),India’s
Premium industrial hub.DAEDALUS is an original design manufacturer(ODM) of Mobile Elevating Work
Platforms (MEWP’s) in INDIA. Our indigenously Designed and Manufactured products boast Robust
Quality, Excellent Value& Long-lasting Efficiency. Since its inception, our customer-centric
business approach has enabled us to grow rapidly in a short period, allowing us to offer a wide
range of products with working heights ranging from 6m to 20m. All our products are designed to
solve your worksite challenges. Our team of industry experts and engineers innovate and develop
cutting-edge solutions through extensive Research and Development methodologies to meet your
changing requirements. We manufacture our products to stringent global standards that help increase
quality, lower costs and give youexceptional value for years to come.DAEDALUS products are
accredited with class-leading CE certification thus reaffirming our product capabilities.

We have developed widespread pan India service network to address any of your requirements. We
strive to maximize your uptime so that you can achieve optimal productivity. Our products are built
to meet the requirement of professionals working at height.

DAEDALUS products find their applications in Space Centers, Railways, Warehouses Infrastructure,
Rentals, Automation, Automobile, Aviation, Pharmaceuticals, and many more Sectors.Our Vast product
range can easily meet the ever-changing demands of various customers and applications. Being an
Indian OEM, DAEDALUS looks forward to forging new and exciting partnerships with customers from all

* Self Propelled Scissor Lift

Characterized by low noise and large working platform, Daedalus Self Propelled Scissor Lifts are the
ideal choice for all worksite applications with firm level surface to increase productivity and ease
of operations.

These scissor lifts are easily maneuverable around compact spaces with its proportional control;
enabling the operator to operate these machines easily. With the weight capacity of 350 Kgs. along
with the electric line to platform; you can be sure to complete all your worksite operations using
our scissor lifts.

[Read More][24]

Our Rough Terrain scissor lifts are impeccable for all your outdoor rough terrain jobsites. With
larger working area and higher lifting capacity; they improve productivity and enhance ease of
operations. With our rough terrain scissor lift you can be sure to get your work finished faster.
They are characterized by high power 2WD functionality along with a larger battery pack; making sure
that your work never stops.

[Read More][25]

Daedalus Push-able Scissor Lifts are introduced and designed to enhance operational productivity.
Characterized as low weight and low cost machines; they are easily maneuvered providing you the
solution for a variety of indoor height applications. With options in power source ranging for
single phase supply to the battery operated versions with an inbuilt battery charger, these machines
are a one stop solution to your industry needs.

[Read More][26]

Its design features such as Zero Tail Swing, Low Turning Radius enable you to access Narrow and
Tight spaces with Ease. These capabilities along with 340° Turret Rotation enable you to reach Hard
to Access work areas. These are an ideal choice of machines for congested and noise-sensitive indoor
environments.

[Read More][27]

12m to 20m; our electric boom lift can be used to work in variety of applications on firm and level
surfaces. These powerful 2WD machines make sure that you don’t face any obstacles.

### เทคนิคสำหรับแทงฝั่งเจ้ามือ (Banker)

การเดิมพันฝั่งเจ้ามือถือเป็นทางเลือกที่ปลอดภัยและมีโอกาสชนะสูงสุดในบาคาร่า ด้วยอัตราการจ่ายที่สมดุล
เทคนิคคือสังเกตรูปแบบไพ่ในแต่ละรอบ หากเจ้ามือชนะต่อเนื่องหลายครั้ง
เลือกตามไหลของเจ้ามือช่วยให้คุณไม่ต้องคิดมากและลดความเสี่ยง แนะนำให้วางเดิมพันฝั่งเจ้ามือเป็นหลัก
เพราะความได้เปรียบทางสถิติอยู่ที่ประมาณ 1.06% ซึ่งถือว่าต่ำที่สุดในเกม

### เทคนิคสำหรับแทงฝั่งผู้เล่น (Player)

เลือกแทงฝั่งผู้เล่นเหมาะกับคนที่ชอบความตื่นเต้นและไม่อยากจ่ายค่าคอมมิชชั่น เทคนิคคือสังเกตรูปแบบไพ่สลับ หรือ ปิงปอง
หากผลออกสลับกันบ่อย เลือกฝั่งผู้เล่นตามจังหวะนี้มักจะง่ายและได้กำลังใจ เพิ่มโอกาสชนะโดยไม่ต้องพึ่งพาโชคเพียงอย่างเดียว

# บาคาร่าออนไลน์ เว็บบาคาร่า ไม่ผ่านเอเย่นต์ คนเล่นเยอะสุดในปีนี้

เว็บ บาคาร่า เป็นพื้นที่ที่คนเล่นบาคาร่าชอบเข้ามาลองเดิมพันเป็นจำนวนมาก แบบไม่ต้องสงสัย เพราะใครที่อยากเล่นแบบจริงจัง
ไม่ชอบระบบยุ่งยาก ต่างก็ย้ายมาเล่นที่นี่กันทั้งนั้น ทำให้คนเล่นเยอะสุด คือความเป็นเว็บตรงแท้ ไม่ผ่านเอเย่นต์ เข้าเกมได้ไว ลื่น
ไม่สะดุด และให้บรรยากาศการเล่นที่มั่นคงกว่าแบบเห็นได้ชัด เล่นแล้วไม่ต้องมาคอยลุ้นเรื่องระบบ

[**บาคาร่าออนไลน์**][15] ยังขึ้นชื่อเรื่องห้องเล่นที่เลือกได้หลากหลาย ที่นี่มีครบหมด รูปแบบวางเดิมพันก็เข้าใจง่าย
ไม่ว่าจะเป็นมือใหม่หรือเล่นมานานก็เข้าถึงได้ทันที หน้าเว็บไซต์มีปุ่มต่างๆที่ออกแบบมาให้ใช้งานง่าย ไม่ซับซ้อน
ทำให้นักพนันจำนวนมากเลือกเว็บของเราเป็นตัวเลือกหลักของปีนี้

[บาคาร่าออนไลน์]

## ประวัติโดยย่อของ เกมบาคาร่า กับการเติบโตที่ไม่มีวันหยุด

ประวัติของบาคาร่าจริงๆ แล้วมีเส้นทางที่น่าสนใจมาก เริ่มตั้งแต่ยุคแรก ๆ ที่เชื่อกันว่าเกมนี้มีต้นกำเนิดในฝรั่งเศส
และถูกพูดถึงครั้งแรกในปี 1847 ในหนังสือของ Charles Van Tenac โดยใช้ชื่อว่า Baccarat Banque หรือ Baccarat à Deux
Tableaux ต่อมาเกมก็ถูกพัฒนาหลายรูปแบบจนกลายเป็นบาคาร่าในแบบที่เราเห็นกันปัจจุบัน

ในโลกออนไลน์ รูปแบบที่คนรู้จักกันมากที่สุดคือ Baccarat Chemin de Fer หรือที่เรียกกันว่า Railway Baccarat
ซึ่งเป็นเวอร์ชันที่ให้ผู้เล่นมีส่วนร่วมมากกว่า ส่วนแบบที่ง่ายที่สุดอย่าง Punto Banco ก็มีการเชื่อกันว่าถูกพัฒนามาจากคาสิโนในฮาวานา
ประเทศคิวบา และกลายเป็นรูปแบบที่เว็บคาสิโนนิยมใช้มากที่สุดในยุคนี้

สำหรับชื่อ “บาคาร่า” เองก็มีหลายทฤษฎี บางคนเชื่อว่ามาจากคำอิตาลีที่แปลว่า ศูนย์ เพราะหน้าไพ่หลายใบมีค่าเป็นศูนย์
แต่ก็ยังไม่มีหลักฐานยืนยันชัดเจน ขณะเดียวกัน นักประวัติศาสตร์เกมอย่าง [Thierry Depaulis][16] ก็เสนอว่า
ชื่อนี้อาจมาจากคำในสำเนียงท้องถิ่นของฝรั่งเศส ที่มีความหมายเกี่ยวกับ ล้มละลาย หรือ หมดตัว ซึ่งอาจสะท้อนลักษณะของเกมในยุคนั้น

## แนวทางการเล่น บาคาร่า แบบง่าย สำหรับผู้ที่เพิ่งเริ่มต้นเล่นบาคาร่าออนไลน์

**เกมบาคาร่า **เป็นเกมที่เล่นง่ายและไม่ซับซ้อนที่สุดเกมหนึ่งในคาสิโน แม้จะเป็นเกมที่อาศัยโชคเป็นหลัก
แต่ก็ยังทำให้สนุกได้ทุกครั้งที่ได้เดิมพัน ความนิยมของบาคาร่าเพิ่มขึ้นอย่างมากหลังจากถูกพูดถึงในนิยาย
และมักจะถูกนำเสนอเป็นเกมประจำของหนังเรื่อง James Bond จนกลายเป็นภาพจำในโลกคาสิโนมาจนถึงปัจจุบัน 

ตัวเกมใช้ไพ่ 6 หรือ 8 สำรับ โดยชื่อ บาคาร่า หมายถึง ศูนย์ ซึ่งสื่อถึงไพ่ที่นับแต้มเป็นศูนย์อย่าง 10, J, Q และ K
หากคุณอยากเริ่มต้นเล่นบาคาร่าออนไลน์ ทางเว็บไซต์ของเราจะพาไปรู้จักตั้งแต่กติกาแบบพื้นฐาน
จนถึงแนวคิดและเทคนิคที่ช่วยให้เล่นได้อย่างมั่นใจยิ่งขึ้น

## ประเภทของ Baccarat online ที่ต้องรู้ก่อนเดิมพัน

**Baccarat** เกมนี้มีประเภทต่างๆให้เลือกเล่นเยอะแยะมากมาย เว็บของเราจะช่วยให้เข้าใจประเภทเกมบาคาร่าต่างๆ
รูปแบบต่างให้เข้าใจง่าย และเลือกเล่นได้ตามฝจชอบของท่านแบบที่เหมาะกับความชอบของท่าน
* **Punto Banco**

เป็นหนึ่งในรูปแบบบาคาร่าที่ได้รับความนิยมมากที่สุดในโลก โดยเฉพาะในคาสิโนเอเชียและในกลุ่มผู้เล่นระดับสูง เกมจะเล่นระหว่าง
Player กับ Banker สิ่งที่ผู้เล่นต้องทำมีเพียงเลือกว่าเดิมพันฝั่งไหนเท่านั้น ผลลัพธ์ของเกมจึงขึ้นอยู่กับโอกาสล้วนๆ ไม่ซับซ้อน
เข้าใจง่ายและเล่นสนุกทุกครั้ง
* **Baccarat Banque**

เป็นรูปแบบดั้งเดิมของบาคาร่าที่เริ่มเล่นมาตั้งแต่ศตวรรษที่ 19 เวอร์ชันนี้ใช้ไพ่ 3 สำรับ 52 ใบ จุดต่างสำคัญคือ ใน Baccarat
Banque เจ้ามือสามารถเล่นต่อได้ตามต้องการ ส่วนแต้มของผู้เล่นจะคงที่ ไม่เปลี่ยนแปลงระหว่างรอบ
* **Mini Baccarat**

เป็นเวอร์ชันย่อของเกมบาคาร่า ที่ถูกออกแบบมาให้เล่นได้ไวและเข้าถึงง่ายกว่าโต๊ะบาคาร่าปกติ โต๊ะของ Mini Baccarat
จะมีขนาดเล็กลง และจำนวนที่นั่งน้อยกว่า โดยทั่วไปมีประมาณ 7 ที่นั่ง ต่างจากโต๊ะบาคาร่าธรรมดาที่รองรับผู้เล่นได้ถึง 14 คน
ลดจำนวนที่นั่งนี้ทำให้เกมดำเนินไปเร็วขึ้น ทำให้แต่ละรอบเกมสั้นลง เล่นง่าย และกระชับมากขึ้น
* **Big Baccarat**

คือรูปแบบบาคาร่าที่ออกแบบมาเพื่อให้ผู้เล่นได้พบกับคาสิโนออนไลน์ที่หรูหราและเต็มรูปแบบ โต๊ะเกมมีขนาดใหญ่ รองรับผู้เล่นได้สูงสุดถึง
14 คน Big Baccarat มักถูกจัดไว้ในห้อง VIP ของคาสิโนออนไลน์
เพื่อให้ผู้เล่นได้ความเป็นส่วนตัวและความเงียบสงบอย่างที่ผู้เล่นระดับสูงต้องการ

เรียนรู้ **กติกาบาคาร่า** ให้เข้าใจก่อนเล่นถือว่าสำคัญมาก เพราะมันช่วยให้เล่น ได้แบบไม่งงกลางเกม หลักง่ายๆ คือ ไพ่หมายเลข
1-9 มีค่าตามหน้าไพ่ ส่วนไพ่ 10, J, Q, K จะมีค่าเป็น 0 ทั้งหมด

วิธีเล่นเริ่มจากแจกไพ่ 4 ใบแบบหงายหน้า แบ่งเป็นฝั่ง Player 2 ใบ และฝั่ง Banker 2 ใบ
หน้าที่ของเราคือเลือกว่าจะวางเดิมพันฝั่งไหนให้แต้มใกล้ 9 ที่สุด ถ้าผลรวมเกิน 9 ให้ตัดเลขหน้าออก เช่น 7 + 7 = 14 ก็จะเหลือแค่

เล่นกับเว็บที่มีสถิติย้อนหลังชัดเจนยิ่งทำให้วิเคราะห์ได้ง่าย****
* **เล่นบาคาร่าแบบหลายโต๊ะพร้อมกัน ทำได้จริงไหม?**

ได้แน่นอน สำหรับคนที่ชอบความท้าทายและไม่อยากพลาดโอกาส สามารถจัดสรรเดิมพันหลายโต๊ะในเวลาเดียวกันได้****
* **บาคาร่าออนไลน์มีอะไรที่แตกต่างจากบาคาร่าในคาสิโนจริง?**

* **เวลาไหนเหมาะกับการเล่นบาคาร่าออนไลน์ที่สุด?**

เวลาว่างหรือช่วงที่คุณสามารถโฟกัสเกมได้เต็มที่ จะช่วยให้วิเคราะห์ไพ่และสนุกได้มากที่สุด****

ผู้เล่นมักสนใจ “แนวเค้าไพ่” เช่นปิงปอง หรือมังกร เพราะช่วยคาดเดาไพ่ในตาต่อไปได้ง่าย

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

Esco Aster.
One World Biosolutions for One Health.

## About Us

Esco Aster was established in 2015 as an intrapreneurial venture within Esco Lifesciences Group,
following the successful commercialization and patenting of its proprietary biomanufacturing
platform—the packed-bed, adherent Tide Motion bioreactor.

Building on early technical validation achieving commercial success in human and animal vaccines and
market potential, Esco Aster was spun out in 2018 as a wholly owned subsidiary to accelerate product
development, strategic partnerships, and market expansion.

On 8 August 2022, Esco Aster completed its spin-off and now operates as an affiliate of Esco
Lifesciences Group, with increased strategic and operational independence to support its growth
trajectory.

Esco Lifesciences Group, headquartered in Singapore since 1978, was founded by a Singaporean
husband-and-wife team of pharmacists, both graduates of the National University of Singapore. The
Group has since evolved into a globally recognized life sciences platform with a strong track record
in innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization.

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

## About Us

Esco Aster was established in 2015 as an intrapreneurial venture within Esco Lifesciences Group,
following the successful commercialization and patenting of its proprietary biomanufacturing
platform—the packed-bed, adherent Tide Motion bioreactor.

Building on early technical validation achieving commercial success in human and animal vaccines and
market potential, Esco Aster was spun out in 2018 as a wholly owned subsidiary to accelerate product
development, strategic partnerships, and market expansion.

On 8 August 2022, Esco Aster completed its spin-off and now operates as an affiliate of Esco
Lifesciences Group, with increased strategic and operational independence to support its growth
trajectory.

Esco Lifesciences Group, headquartered in Singapore since 1978, was founded by a Singaporean
husband-and-wife team of pharmacists, both graduates of the National University of Singapore. The
Group has since evolved into a globally recognized life sciences platform with a strong track record
in innovation, manufacturing, and commercialization.

[Innovative Handler Automobile and Vehicle Solutions for Every Industry][187]
Handler's specialized vehicle excels in a wide range of application scenarios, showcasing its
versatility and efficiency. On construction sites, the specialized vehicle is ideal for the
installation, maintenance, and cleaning of building exterior walls, windows, curtain walls, and
other high facilities. In commercial buildings and public facilities, such as large shopping
centers, stadiums, exhibition centers, airports, and stations, it proves invaluable for lighting
maintenance, facility upkeep, and the replacement of advertising signs. Additionally, in urban
maintenance and services, Handler's specialized vehicle is perfect for tasks like urban road
lighting maintenance, traffic signal light upkeep, and urban greening tree pruning. Its adaptability
and reliability make it an essential tool for various aerial work needs.

# Product series

Hengwang's main products include four major categories and over 40 types, such as drilling rigs,
pile drivers, construction machinery, and parts. Relying on technological innovation, the company
continues to achieve breakthroughs in the fields of new energy and intelligent modification.

### Construction Machinery

Hengwang Group's construction machinery business encompasses excavators, road rollers, loaders,
forklifts, and transport vehicles. With a global presence, the company has established production,
sales, and distribution networks worldwide, catering to a wide range of engineering needs.

Learn more
][116]
[

### Drilling Rig

This includes various drilling equipment such as pneumatic, hydraulic, borehole, and exploration
equipment. The products exhibit excellent performance and reliability, making them suitable for
various geological exploration, engineering drilling, and multi-sector needs.

Learn more
][117]
[

### Pile Driver

We produce various pile foundation equipment, including photovoltaic pile drivers, guardrail pile
drivers, drilling rigs, auger excavators, and more, providing reliable solutions for a wide range of
foundation engineering projects.

Learn more
][118]
[

### Parts

Components form the core of the equipment, directly determining the equipment's performance,
reliability, and lifespan. We adhere to the principles of employing advanced manufacturing
techniques and high-quality materials, ensuring that each component undergoes rigorous quality
control and testing.

### Design

In terms of customized hydraulic lifting platform, with our mature design experience and advanced
design concepts accumulated by serving the world's top manufacturers for many years, we can not only
provide customers with accurate and reliable rigid demand design, but also in the greatest extent.
To meet the flexible needs of customers, such as high-value content in terms of drawing guarantee,
ease of use, ease of maintenance, cost reduction, safety assurance, etc., with the spirit of
craftsmanship, we will earnestly implement our solemn commitment to customers!

### Manufacturer

After years of development, HESHAN INDUSTRY has continuously pursued technological progress and is
committed to product innovation; advanced and reasonable technology, complete testing equipment,
high modern management level and strong design and production capabilities. Has a modern production
workshop, all kinds of advanced production equipment. Various types of hydraulic lifting platforms
and other products produced by the company are widely used in aviation, aerospace, railway, electric
power, steel, logistics and other industries. Now the company has become a cooperative supplier of
many steel groups and power groups.

### Supply

Heshan Industry is a manufacturer of hydraulic lifting platforms, aerial work vehicles, car rotating
booths, boarding bridges, mobile handling equipment, home elevators and other mechanical products.
Through years of efforts, Juli's products have been purchased by many foreign countries. Recognized
by the family, the company's export orders have grown exponentially in recent years.

### Installation

The company provides installation and maintenance manuals for each customer. Standard products do
not need to be installed. The whole machine is delivered and can be used immediately after receipt.

### Infrastructure

Our company has a complete production line, rich industry experience and an efficient team, with
innovative production concepts, introducing advanced production technology, and creating
satisfactory production quality. Modern standard workshop, the introduction of various processing
and testing equipment: CNC machine tools, large gantry milling machines, lathes, grinders,
pipe-making equipment, etc. The product adopts systematic data management from the design scheme of
raw material procurement, production, processing, finished product testing, and packaging.

# Bringing Your Next-Level Lift Solution

**We pride ourselves on providing the safest and most efficient access solutions for the toughest to
reach places.**

As the industry leader and a division of the [HOLT Group][81], we pride ourselves in providing
access solutions for the toughest to reach places. We have the largest fleet of MEWP (mobile
elevating work platforms) in North American and are the largest distributor of the [Bronto
Skylifts][82], the safest and most reliable aerial work platform on the market.

We have truck-mounted aerials equipped with versatile telescoping booms reaching heights up to 341
feet. Access your project from 131 feet away with the impressive horizontal reach or perform
inspections on the underside of a bridge up to 50 feet below ground level.

## Bronto Skylift

** Aerial platforms for safe working at extreme heights.**

[HOLT Aerial Bronto Skylifts][88] deliver reliable, safe, and customized height access solutions

# Bringing Your Next-Level Lift Solution

**We pride ourselves on providing the safest and most efficient access solutions for the toughest to
reach places.**

As the industry leader and a division of the [HOLT Group][81], we pride ourselves in providing
access solutions for the toughest to reach places. We have the largest fleet of MEWP (mobile
elevating work platforms) in North American and are the largest distributor of the [Bronto
Skylifts][82], the safest and most reliable aerial work platform on the market.

We have truck-mounted aerials equipped with versatile telescoping booms reaching heights up to 341
feet. Access your project from 131 feet away with the impressive horizontal reach or perform
inspections on the underside of a bridge up to 50 feet below ground level.

[ Request Quote ][83]

## Bronto Skylift

** Aerial platforms for safe working at extreme heights.**

[HOLT Aerial Bronto Skylifts][88] deliver reliable, safe, and customized height access solutions
with 50 years of engineering excellence.

Our aerials, manufactured in Finland, meet North American DOT, ANSI, and OSHA standards, ensuring
high uptime for secure and efficient operations. Learn more about our [Commitment to Safety][89].

[HOLT Aerial Bronto Skylifts][90] enhance performance in challenging environments with advanced
controls, one-button automatic outrigger leveling, and easy maneuverability for quick setup. We
offer operated or bare [rentals][91] , [new][92] and [used][93] units, and custom orders for
specialty or insulated trucks.

[ About Bronto Skylift ][94]
[ HOLT Aerial Product Guide ][95]

## Training

**Exceeding the norm. **

All [HOLT Aerial][96] operators receive extensive training (both in-classroom and on-site) to match
or exceed the criteria of [Bronto Skylift][97].

Training includes emergency procedures, troubleshooting tactics, and safe practices for operating
and driving. It is also open to customers who wish to operate their own equipment.

[ HOLT Aerial Careers ][98]

## Service Areas

**[HOLT Aerial][99] proudly serves customers nationwide. **

Our units are located across North America, allowing us to provide better availability, lower
mobilization costs, and lower overall rates.

Depuis le début de son histoire, LOXAM a toujours eu à l’esprit d’être pionnier dans son domaine,
avec cette volonté de rechercher constamment la satisfaction de ses clients.

Aujourd’hui, leader européen du marché de la location de matériels et d’outillages pour le BTP,
l’industrie, les espaces verts et les services, le Groupe LOXAM est implanté dans 28 pays sur 4
continents.

precision by touching the screen to negotiate turns and release at the right moment to find the
perfect trajectory and drift in style. The challenge is significant, as you will navigate through
oversized environments where everyday objects become monumental obstacles.

### Passing of Madame Jacqueline Himsworth, Chairman of the Board of Directors of Manitou Group

Председатель совета директоров Manitou Group, Ансенис, 11 апреля 2026 г. – С глубоким волнением и
безмерной скорбью Manitou Group сообщает о кончине г-жи Жаклин Химсворт, председателя совета
директоров компании, которая скончалась сегодня в возрасте 82 лет.
[ More information ][76]
[main visual lift and drift home article]

### **Lift & Drift**: The XXL Adventure

Discover our new video mobile game:"Lift and Drift". It offers a gaming experience that is as easy
to learn as it is challenging to master. The concept is simple: steer your mini-machine with
precision by touching the screen to negotiate turns and release at the right moment to find the
perfect trajectory and drift in style. The challenge is significant, as you will navigate through
oversized environments where everyday objects become monumental obstacles.
[ Discover our mobile game ][77]
[manitou homepage block BIM library]

### **BIM files**: Valuable tools for worksite management!

As real 3D visualization tools, Manitou BIM files allow you to integrate our machines into your
digital mockup and put them into practice in all your construction applications. Each BIM object
contains the technical data of the machine (dimensions, weight, ground clearance, etc.) to help you
optimize work on your sites, from design to deconstruction. Better communication and collaboration,
cost and time management, decision-making support, global visualization of the project, productivity
and quality increased, are all reasons to use our BIM files!
[ Check out our BIM files! ][78]
Discover the company
Our head office based in France is in line with the values defended by the creators of the Manitou
brand: to create handling machines that are ever more innovative and efficient.
[ To know more about it ][79]

**Manitou Group **is a French company based in Loire-Atlantique, specializing in the **manufacture
of handling**, lifting and earthmoving equipment for agriculture, construction and industries. Our
machines, such as **aerial work platforms** and **mast forklift trucks**, are also used in sectors
such as aeronautics, defense, environment, mining, etc. With more than 60 years of experience based
on continuous innovation, Manitou offers ergonomic and easy-to-handle machines that meet all your
requirements, with a high level of safety, comfort, and performance.

Discover here and at our dealers all of our handling and **construction equipment solutions:
construction telehandlers**, agricultural telehandlers, **rotating telehandlers**, articulated
loaders, truck mounted forklifts,** forklift trucks**, skid steer loader, track loader, wheel
loader...The many Manitou Group Attachments will complete the capacities and applications of your
machines: clamp, bucket, winch... to lift, move, position, dig, tow...

You will also find our complete range of services: financing, extended coverage, maintenance,
connected solutions, training....

### **Lift & Drift**: The XXL Adventure

Discover our new video mobile game:"Lift and Drift". It offers a gaming experience that is as easy
to learn as it is challenging to master. The concept is simple: steer your mini-machine with
precision by touching the screen to negotiate turns and release at the right moment to find the
perfect trajectory and drift in style. The challenge is significant, as you will navigate through
oversized environments where everyday objects become monumental obstacles.
[ Discover our mobile game ][77]
[manitou homepage block BIM library]

### **BIM files**: Valuable tools for worksite management!

As real 3D visualization tools, Manitou BIM files allow you to integrate our machines into your
digital mockup and put them into practice in all your construction applications. Each BIM object
contains the technical data of the machine (dimensions, weight, ground clearance, etc.) to help you
optimize work on your sites, from design to deconstruction. Better communication and collaboration,
cost and time management, decision-making support, global visualization of the project, productivity
and quality increased, are all reasons to use our BIM files!
[ Check out our BIM files! ][78]
Discover the company
Our head office based in France is in line with the values defended by the creators of the Manitou
brand: to create handling machines that are ever more innovative and efficient.
[ To know more about it ][79]

**Manitou Group **is a French company based in Loire-Atlantique, specializing in the **manufacture
of handling**, lifting and earthmoving equipment for agriculture, construction and industries. Our
machines, such as **aerial work platforms** and **mast forklift trucks**, are also used in sectors
such as aeronautics, defense, environment, mining, etc. With more than 60 years of experience based
on continuous innovation, Manitou offers ergonomic and easy-to-handle machines that meet all your
requirements, with a high level of safety, comfort, and performance.

Discover here and at our dealers all of our handling and **construction equipment solutions:
construction telehandlers**, agricultural telehandlers, **rotating telehandlers**, articulated
loaders, truck mounted forklifts,** forklift trucks**, skid steer loader, track loader, wheel
loader...The many Manitou Group Attachments will complete the capacities and applications of your
machines: clamp, bucket, winch... to lift, move, position, dig, tow...

You will also find our complete range of services: financing, extended coverage, maintenance,
connected solutions, training....

**About Us
**
Incorporated in the year 2013, we, M Tech Corporation are offering the world-class Material Handling
Equipment. We are a noteworthy Manufacturer, Exporter, Trader and Supplier of Dock Leveler, Scissor
Lift, Hydraulic Scissor Lift, Arial Birth Platform, Car Lifts, Storage Tank, Heavy Duty Storage Rack
and Aerial Birth Platform.

Our product range also embraces Hydraulic Lifting Equipment, Hydraulic Scissors Lift, Scissor Lift
Table, Aerial Platforms, Car Lift, Drum lifter, Hydraulic Stacker, Pallets Truck, Storage Racks and
much more.

All our products are made of good quality materials and the advanced technologies. This is why, our
entire product range is highly appreciated in the markets. Our products are known for their long
working life, good tensile strength, rugged construction, large capacity and low maintenance costs.
It is due to these surpassed features, our products are used by several manufacturing and logistics
organization for handling their goods in a convenient manner.
